forbidden.name: lib-and-api-are-the-bottom
forbidden.comment: The layers of src, from the bottom: lib and api, components, features, app; a layer imports only from the layers below it (type-only imports count). src/lib and src/api know nothing of components, features or the app.

forbidden.name: components-below-features
forbidden.comment: A shared component takes what it shows through props. One that needs a feature belongs to that feature, or is handed it by the app.

forbidden.name: features-below-app
forbidden.comment: src/app composes the features (router, shell); no feature reaches back into it.

forbidden.name: test-support-only-in-tests
forbidden.comment: src/test holds what the boundary tests share; shipped code never imports it.

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Modules that import each other, directly or through others, cannot be understood or loaded apart.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: A module nothing imports and that imports nothing is a leftover.
